reviews.title: Looks nice. So far so good.
reviews.comment:
[Employee of bestbuy] Solid board. 

Pros: Good power delivery design.
No coil whine as far as I can tell with stress test.
Looks great. Sturdy. Minimal on board RGB.
Easy install. LOTS OF EXPANDABILITY.
Top m.2 slot shares lane with PCIe 5 x16. Other two slots each have their own separate lanes.
Easy detach for beefy GPUs.
Straight forward BIOS and EXPO enabling.
5 year warranty.
Out of the box support for Ryzen 7800X3D so no need to flash the BIOS.

Cons:
Kinda pricey but what isn't these days.
Box does not come with security seal so I can only assume this one hasn't been opened. The first one I ordered had divots near the opening flap that made me second guess if it was opened before or not.
